'''David Teeters''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 I-10 Cup (April)]] on 7 April 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Andy's Endor Ops w/ AT-STs (1417)]], according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2055">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-10-viper-is-cool-tucson-i-10-cup-4-7-01d2055/ viper-is-cool-tucson-i-10-cup-4-7-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 10 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-10-viper-is-cool-tucson-i-10-cup-4-7-01d2055/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
